notes.title: Big Update & New Platforms!
notes.content:
Hi people! 🚪⬆️

We have exciting news for you! [b]Death Elevator[/b] has just received a major update on Steam! Alongside this, the game is now officially available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4/5, Xbox One, and Series X|S for just $9.99.

But that’s not all—Steam players get an exclusive deal! To thank you for your support, we’re keeping the price at $7.99 with a 10% launch discount for a limited time.

What’s New in the Update?
👉 Global Leaderboard: Compete with players worldwide to claim the top spot!
👉 Input remapping and performance optimization!
👉 New Platforms: Take the Death Elevator challenge wherever you go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336096/64cd70a4e2d964622a19cd54089e84fe12680a8e.png[/img]

If you’re already playing, don’t forget to update your game, try out the new features, and leave us a Steam review! Your feedback makes all the difference.

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*]⚡ Fast Movement: Dash through randomized floors at breakneck speed.
[*]🕒 Slow Motion: Survive deadly moments with precision as time slows down.
[*]🏢 Randomized Rooms & Weapons: Every run feels fresh and exciting.
[*]📈 Score System: Challenge your friends and climb the leaderboard!
[*]🕵️ Interpretative Plot: Uncover the mysteries of the elevator.
[/list]

New to Death Elevator? Now is the perfect time to experience this skill-based roguelike where every bullet is lethal, and survival is the ultimate prize.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 - Aim Assist Patch
notes.content:
This patch includes new features and several bug fixes :D
The newest feature added was the Aim Assist option, but I'll list down every change included in this patch!

[u]New Features[/u]

- Bullet tracer: Now every shot leaves a trail so you can adjust your aim on the following shots, helping you to be more accurate
-  Aim Assist: You can turn it on and off on the settings menu, the aim assist was mainly designed to provide a better experience to gamepad users but everyone can use it :D 
- Bullet SFX update: When you shoot a bullet the sound effect is now more exaggerated, making the game more stylish, it also makes it more clear to understand that you can actually shoot bullets

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

- Grenade Launcher: An issue that caused the grenade launcher to shoot incorrectly at times has been corrected, now the grenade launcher is consistent and every shot will work correctly
- Ammo Inconsistency: Some weapons would be empty at 0 ammo and some at 1. Now every weapon has the extra "zero bullet"
- Camera Effect When Jumping: The player could spawn a camera effect by pressing jump on air, leading to some players expecting a double jump. Now the camera effect only happens when you jump off the ground
- Adjusted navigation paths: Some areas had a navigation problem where chaser enemies would fall off the top of a building, these navigation paths was corrected so the enemies work better now
- Shooting while dead: An issue where you kept shooting an automatic weapon after dying was corrected
